text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After spending some time out with Red 
Desire, my phone suddenly started ringing.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please, go ahead and answer the call from 
over yonder. I shall keep watch over the 
surroundings.
choice_data_list: (...It's from Loves)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she has plenty of connections as a 
streamer, we had asked her to help look 
for Red Desire's lost brooch, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I found the brooch you were looking for! 
♪ My child picked it up at the park and 
let me know."
choice_data_list: Really!?
Really!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. The serial number on the back 
matches the one I heard from Desire 
earlier."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Oh my. Are you finished speaking?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, so... there's something I want to 
tell you.

Yeah, so... there's something I want to 
tell you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way to meet Loves Only You at our 
rendezvous point, I decided to tell her 
the truth.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So then, what you received back then was 
different from the brooch you had lost.
choice_data_list: Sorry! And that was your one and only...
Sorry! And that was your one and only...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is quite all right... You did it out of 
concern for me, did you not? Then it is 
perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah, both of you... Um, over here!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The person who found it is inside. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Mother of the Finder
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, Shi-chan. Let's give the 
brooch back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Girl Who Found It
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, but... it's mine. It wanted me to 
pick it up...

text_block_list.name: Mother of the Finder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you silly thing... Big Sis is the real 
owner, okay? Let's give it back to her, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: You heard the brooch's voice, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Girl Who Found It
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Then it already belongs to you.
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Not just anyone can hear the voice. It is 
an encounter with destiny—a revelation 
from "that place."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...In an encounter from days gone by, I, 
too, heard the call of the brooch."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, those are distant memories now. The 
one this brooch seeks today must be you.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, young lady.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Every time I looked at that brooch, my 
resolve to be a saint surged within me, 
and gave me the courage to overcome any 
trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it will be a great source of 
support for you.

text_block_list.name: Girl Who Found It
text_block_list.text:
………… Big sister, are you really sure about 
this?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because... I already have "my own 
brooch."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Allow me to make one confession.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Back when you gave me that other brooch, 
Trainer... I had already realized.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You're saying the numbers of the gospel 
differ?
choice_data_list: ...! Then, from the very beginning—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You were worried about me running 
around day after day on this lost-item 
trial, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The noble compassion you showed me back 
then was unmistakably genuine—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Which is why, that moment you gave it to 
me, that brooch became 'the real thing' to 
me too."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For this one-of-a-kind, precious brooch... 
Thank you so much.
choice_data_list: I really appreciate your kindness too.
Your kindness makes me happy too
She's a saintess……

Once again, won't you let me pour my 
feelings into it?

Once again, will you let me pour my heart 
into it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For this one-of-a-kind, precious brooch... 
Thank you so much.
choice_data_list: I really appreciate your kindness too.
Your kindness makes me happy too
She's a saintess……

Once again, won't you let me pour my 
feelings into it?

Once again, will you let me pour my heart 
into it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Thanks to this brooch, we've been 
bound by an even stronger bond—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"As expected, blessings await beyond the 
trials we overcome, don't they?♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Red Desire so happy brought a 
bright smile to my own face as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I muttered out loud without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...? Yes, of course. I am a Saint, you 
know?
choice_data_list: Well, that may be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that the smile she directed at 
me was so dazzling, the words just slipped 
out of my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I practice my benevolent smile in 
front of the mirror every day. It's the 
fruit of my saintly training♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire was her usual self. Looking at 
her, I couldn't help but feel she was 
dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Your feelings, Trainer?
choice_data_list: It might not be much, but...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"No, not at all! Please, I would be 
honored...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the brooch from Red Desire, I pour 
my feelings into it.
choice_data_list: May this brooch protect the Saintess...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, it's warm.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I shall continue to take on trials 
carrying Trainer's feelings with me!
